_comment: Crosswalk from MyCoach's historical exercise_title strings onto exercise_id. Built for wayfinder ticket #59; consumed by the exercise-identity migration in #56 to backfill exercise_id. Reviewable, hand-checked artifact -- not a one-off script. Titles are the exact strings stored in GymWorkoutDetail.exercise_title; the backfill must match them verbatim. match: exact=identity after spelling normalisation; judgement=hand-picked variant of an unambiguous movement; athlete=movement identity confirmed by the athlete; local=promoted into MyCoach's local catalogue overlay.

catalogue.note: Upstream ids resolved against the authoritative pin. Revalidate every upstream exercise_id when re-pinning; reserved mycoach: ids are preserved from the local overlay.

entries.note: Exact after normalising the app's 'Dumbell' spelling.

Promoted to MyCoach's local catalogue overlay because the pinned upstream has no Bulgarian (rear-foot-elevated) split squat. The reserved mycoach: namespace survives upstream re-pins without colliding with upstream slugs.
Unqualified 'Deadlift' -> the conventional barbell deadlift. Catalogue has no bare 'Deadlift'.
Dumbbell standing side/lateral raise. Token-matcher misranked toward rear-delt variants; Side_Lateral_Raise is the standard lateral raise and is dumbbell-equipped.
Dumbbell overhead/shoulder press. Standing vs seated not distinguished in history; Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press is the generic catalogue entry for the movement.
Bare 'Pull Up' -> bodyweight Pullups. Missed by token match (catalogue joins the word as 'Pullups').
Incline is the defining trait; catalogue's Incline Dumbbell Curl is performed seated on an incline bench.
'Skullcrusher' is a synonym for the lying triceps extension; dumbbell equipment matches. Synonym gap not catchable by string similarity.
Bare 'Standing Calf Raise' -> the machine Standing Calf Raises (plural in catalogue). Not the barbell/dumbbell-loaded variants.
Overhead dumbbell triceps extension; the conventional reading of a bare dumbbell triceps extension.
